description: Do you need a body to think? This is a worthwhile (and also a perplexing) question, and an ongoing debate amongst roboticists. Cognitive Roboticist Dr. Mark Bickhard is part of a field of belief that cognition and intelligence - and maybe consciousness itself - requires embodiment and direct interaction with the world. In this interview, he discusses the concept of normative function and self maintenance in entities, and why this matters when it comes to thinking.
classificationReason: Directly examines embodiment, cognition, normative function, and interaction with the world in robotics.
qualityReason: Original expert interview presenting a focused conceptual discussion.
